fundamentals.long_business_summary: Meridian3 Industrials Acquisition Corp 1 focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is based in New York, New York. Meridian3 Industrials Acquisition Corp operates as a subsidiary of Meridian3 Partners Sponsor LLC.
